packageRules.description: The two bengous/stack-watch includes of mise.toml move together, in one PR to the newest toolchain-YYYY.MM.DD tag, merged once every check is green. semver-coerced, the default versioning, reads such a tag as unstable and proposes nothing. The year is the major, so the yearly tag merges too. A tag is the owner's own release: it skips the release age.
